# Rummy Appendix

Rummy Appendix is an independent English-language directory for Android rummy, card, and casual game discovery. It helps readers compare names, source logos, platforms, and visible product information before requesting access. It is not the developer or publisher of listed apps.

## Editorial scope
Listings are informational. Verify app identity, publisher, and regional availability before installing third-party software. The Download button opens a contact prompt and does not expose a direct file URL.
